reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per product, numbered within its category from the highest cost
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS cost_rank
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur, cost_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE cost_rank <= 2

other_way.tradeoff: QUALIFY filters the window result in the same query, which is shorter, but PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server do not accept it.
